newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end firmer, at highs amid spec buying.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end firmer, at highs amid spec buying.

text.p: FCOJ futures finished firmer after a late-session bout of speculative buying lifted the market to session highs, trading sources said.
Prices lingered close to unchanged in early dealings but climbed higher after the speculators touched off stops between 77.00 and 77.50 cents a lb in July delivery.
The contract rallied to 78.50 cents and then drifted in thin trade until additional buying emerged on the close to lift prices to the highs.
July juice settled up 2.20 cents at 79.00 cents after trading from 79.00 to 76.40. Second-position September finished 2.05 higher at 81.50 cents, and the outer contracts settled 1.90 to 1.15 higher.
Technical analysts said the market has probably formed a bottom around 76.00 cents, the low hit on Tuesday and the contract's weakest level since falling to 74.90 on May 12.
Nearby resistance was pegged at 79.90, the high reached on June 6, and then at 86.75 cents, a high made on May 19.
Volume was estimated at 2,000 lots, compared with Tuesday's official 2,238 lots.
The market awaits on USDA's June supply and demand estimates for the Florida crop, released Thursday at 0830 EDT.
Market sources do not expect USDA to revise the May estimate, which pegged the 1996/97 Florida crop at 224.2 million 90-lb boxes, and yields at 1.58 gallons per box.
